item.title: Grey literature and where to find it
item.description: Did you know that almost every detail about the design and operation of a nuclear power plant is online? You can download it, for free, legally, from the Nuclear Regulatory Comission. Dont belive me? Have a look: NRC ADAMS Search. This is just one example of “Grey Literature”, defined as government, academic, or industry documents which are not published by a commercial publisher.
